# OpenEduCat

> Open-source education ERP platform providing comprehensive student information, course management, financial operations, and learning tools for K-12 schools and universities.

OpenEduCat is a unified, modular education management system built on open-source principles (LGPL v3) that integrates student administration, academic operations, financial management, and learning delivery. It supports both cloud and on-premise deployments with integrations for video conferencing (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet), payment processing (Stripe, PayPal), and communication (WhatsApp).

## Key Topics

- Student Information System (SIS)
- Education ERP
- Course Management
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Grade Management & CGPA
- Admission Automation
- Fee Management
- Attendance Tracking
- Exam Management
- Enrollment CRM
- Open Source (LGPL v3)
- Multi-campus Operations
- Integration Ecosystem
- Higher Education
- K-12 Schools

## Core Features

- [Student Information System (SIS)](https://openeducat.org/feature-student-information-system): Student Information System feature for K-12 and universities
- [Course Management Software](https://openeducat.org/feature-course-management-system): Course management with prerequisites, batches, and degree audits
- [Learning Management System (LMS)](https://openeducat.org/feature-lms): Learning Management System integrated with SIS and gradebook
- [Admission Management Software](https://openeducat.org/feature-admission-management-system): Admission automation with applications, merit lists, and enrollment
- [Fee Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-financial-management-system): Fee management with invoicing, scholarships, and reconciliation
- [Gradebook Software for Schools](https://openeducat.org/feature-gradebook): Gradebook with weighted grades, report cards, and parent visibility

## Academic Operations

- [Exam Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-exam-management-system): Exam scheduling, hall tickets, and result publication system
- [Timetable Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-timetable-management-system): Conflict-free schedule generation with automatic room and faculty assignment
- [Attendance Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-attendance-management-system): Attendance tracking with absence alerts and parent notifications
- [Assignment Management Software](https://openeducat.org/feature-assignment-management-system): Digital assignment submission with rubric scoring and gradebook sync
- [Faculty Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-faculty-management-system): Faculty profiles, workload tracking, and credential management

## Learning & Collaboration

- [Live Virtual Classroom](https://openeducat.org/feature-live-classroom): Virtual classroom with Zoom/Teams integration and auto-attendance
- [Library Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-library): Library catalog, circulation tracking, and fine management system

## Institutional Management

- [Campus & Hostel Management System](https://openeducat.org/feature-campus): Hostel allocation, facility booking, and multi-campus operations
- [Enrollment CRM for Higher Education](https://openeducat.org/feature-crm): Enrollment CRM for lead management and student recruitment pipeline
- [E-Commerce for Universities](https://openeducat.org/feature-ecommerce): E-commerce store for courses, certifications, and event ticket sales
